title: RSVP Meal Choice Coverage
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:checklist`), seating revisions (`event:seating`), vendor contracts (`event:vendor`), deposits (`event:deposit`), planning syncs (`event:sync`).
app: Wedding and event-planning telemetry — The Knot checklist exports, seating-chart revisions, vendor deposit schedules, and RSVP operations — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:vendor meal_option=* meal_choice_captured=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(meal_choice_captured="yes",1,0))) as matched by meal_option
| eval a_captured_meal_choice_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_captured_meal_choice_pct
description: Measures the percentage of RSVP records that end with a captured meal choice by meal option.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which meal option are helping or hurting RSVP records.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a captured meal choice` on `event:vendor` events and summarize the hit rate by `meal_option`.
visualization: Table of meal option with percentage of RSVP records ending with a captured meal choice.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how often a captured meal choice happens for each meal option so you can see where RSVP records go smoothly or get stuck.
